item.title: Stage North’s Double Feature Radio Show auditions
item.description: Stage North's production of 9 to 5 still has shows tonight at tomorrow night at the NPCC (get your tickets now at npcc.bc.ca), but they're also holding auditions for their next show that will be performed in May. JP is here to talk about "War of The Worlds" and "Sleepwalker", a pair of radio shows he's looking to perform live with actors and live sound effects.
